documents_belongs.name: documents_belongs
documents_belongs.value: ("documents"."kind" = 'delivery_note' and "documents"."receipt_id" is not null) or ("documents"."kind" = 'invoice' and "documents"."purchase_order_id" is not null)

items_shelf_life_check.name: items_shelf_life_check
items_shelf_life_check.value: ("items"."shelf_life" is null and "items"."shelf_life_unit" is null) or ("items"."shelf_life" between 1 and 3650 and "items"."shelf_life_unit" is not null)
